create.name: InsightLA
create.bio:
InsightLA is a non-profit meditation community in Los Angeles that teaches insight meditation and Buddhist practice in the Theravada tradition, alongside secular courses in mindfulness and self-compassion. Trudy Goodman, a long-time vipassana teacher and psychotherapist, is its founding teacher, and the community has run classes, retreats and special events across the city for around twenty-five years. A Dharma Council of senior teachers, among them Jack Kornfield, supports its teaching, and a group of teachers trained within the community now leads much of the programme.

It has two homes: a meditation centre on Olympic Boulevard in Santa Monica, used for weekly sitting groups, classes and daylongs, and a retreat house in Benedict Canyon above Beverly Hills for weekend and non-residential retreats. Much of what it offers is hybrid, so people can join on Zoom as well. Weekly groups and many classes are offered on a donation basis, with pay-what-you-can places held back for those who need them; there are weekday morning sits, a Spanish-language group, affinity sanghas, longer residential retreats at hired centres and a year-long programme for experienced students. Recorded talks are shared on YouTube.

courses.title: New Year's Retreat 2026-27
courses.description: A four-night silent residential retreat to see out the year, held at the Mary and Joseph Retreat Center, led by Melissa McKay and Dave Smith: sitting and walking practice, guided meditations, talks and question sessions, with vegetarian meals. The teachers are supported separately through dana.

courses.title: (Hybrid: In-person) Wise Intention in the New Year Weekend Retreat
courses.description: A non-residential silent weekend at the Benedict Canyon Retreat House with Celeste Young, looking at New Year intentions from acceptance rather than self-improvement, through mindfulness, lovingkindness, inquiry and a daily talk. Also offered online.

courses.title: (Hybrid: In-person) Deepening the Path: A Yearlong Program for Experienced Practitioners (2027)
courses.description: A year-long cohort for students with solid silent-retreat experience: six non-residential weekends at Benedict Canyon, each led by senior insight teachers including Jack Kornfield and Trudy Goodman, Kamala Masters, Diana Winston, Celeste Young and James Baraz, mixing practice, talks and discussion.

courses.title: (Online) A Boundless Heart: A Metta Daylong
courses.description: A day of lovingkindness practice on Zoom with Beth Sternlieb: what metta is and is not, the traditional phrases, walking practice, the companion qualities of compassion, joy and equanimity, and frank talk about what gets in the way. Open to beginners.

free_resources.title: Morning Community Sit – Every Monday through Friday
free_resources.description: Half an hour of guided meditation on Zoom each weekday at 7:30am Pacific with senior teacher Beth Sternlieb, then optional silent sitting and questions. Offered by donation; registration is needed.

free_resources.title: Sunday Morning Group
free_resources.description: A weekly Sunday practice group at the Santa Monica centre and online, led in rotation by a small teacher team: guided sitting, a talk on the month's theme, then questions and sharing. Drop-in and donation-based; all levels welcome.
